questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: At $300 \mathrm{~K}, 3.0$ moles of an ideal gas at 3.0 atm pressure is compressed isothermally to one half of its volume by an external pressure of 6.0 atm . The work done (in kJ ) is $\left(\right.$ Given, $\left.\mathrm{R}=0$.082 $\mathrm{~L} \mathrm{~atm}\mathrm{~K}^{-1}\mathrm{~mol}^{-1}$\right)$(1 \mathrm{~L}\mathrm{~atm}=$101.3 $\mathrm{~J})$
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \text{For ideal gas, } \\ & \text{Mole }=3 \\ & \text{Temp }=300 \mathrm{ K} \\ & \text{Pressure }=3 \mathrm{ atm} \\ & \text{PV }=\mathrm{nRT} \\ & \mathrm{V}=\frac{\mathrm{nRT}}{\mathrm{P}}=\frac{3 \mathrm{ mole} \times 0.082 \mathrm{c} \mathrm{atm} \mathrm{K}^{-1} \mathrm{ mol}^{-1} \times 300 \mathrm{ K}}{3 \mathrm{ atm}} \\ & \mathrm{ V}_1=24.6 \mathrm{ L} \\ & \therefore \mathrm{ V}_2=\frac{\mathrm{V}_1}{2}=\frac{24.6}{2}=12.3 \\ & \Delta \mathrm{ V}=\mathrm{V}_2-\mathrm{V}_1 \\ & =12.3-24.6 \\ & \Delta \mathrm{ V}=-12.3 \mathrm{ L} \\ & \mathrm{P}_{\mathrm{ext}}=6 \mathrm{ atm} \\ & \mathrm{ W}=-\mathrm{P}_{\text{ext }}(\Delta \mathrm{V}) \\ & =-6 \times(-12.3) \mathrm{atm} \mathrm{L} \\ & =73.8 \mathrm{ atm} \mathrm{ L} \\ & \mathrm{ Win} \mathrm{kJ}=\frac{73.8 \times 101.3 \mathrm{ kJ}}{1000} \\ & \mathrm{ W}=7.476 \mathrm{ kJ} .\end{aligned}$

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The standard enthalpy of combustion of C (graphite), $\mathrm{H}_2$ (g) and $\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{OH}(l)$ respectively are $-393,-286$ and -726 $\mathrm{kJ} \mathrm{mol}^{-1}$. What is the standard enthalpy of formation of methanol?
questions.solution: $\begin{array}{l}\mathrm{C}$+$\mathrm{O}_{2}$ \rightarrow, $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$ \Delta $\mathrm{H}=$-393 $\mathrm{ kJ} \mathrm{ mol}^{-1}$\\2 $\mathrm{H}_{2}+\mathrm{O}_{2}  → 2 \mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{O}$, \Delta $\mathrm{H}=-2 \times286=-572  \mathrm{ kJ}\mathrm{ mol}^{-1}\\ \mathrm{CO}_2+$2$\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}$ \rightarrow $\mathrm{CH}_3\mathrm{OH}+\mathrm{O}_2, \Delta \mathrm{H}=+$726 \\\hline  $\mathrm{C}+$2  $\mathrm{H}_2+2\mathrm{O}_2$ \rightarrow $\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{OH}+\mathrm{O}_2$\Delta $\mathrm{H}=-239  \mathrm{ kJ}\mathrm{ mol}^{-1}\\\mathrm{C}+2 \mathrm{H}_{2}+ \mathrm{O}_{2} \rightarrow \mathrm{CH}_{3}\mathrm{OH} \quad \Delta \mathrm{H}$=$-239  \mathrm{ kJ} \mathrm{ mol}^{-1}\end{array}$
